title: Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupAssignmentScheduleRequests
description: A PIM for Groups time-bound ACTIVE assignment: a user or group made an active member (accessId member) or owner (accessId owner) of a group until a date or for a duration. The resource name is a deterministic GUID chosen with guid() (a label, not the identity); the assignment is matched by (groupId, principalId, accessId) and read live on every run. Created with action adminAssign, changed in place with adminUpdate, removed with adminRemove; justification and ticketInfo are request metadata, sent on every request and never compared. The schedule must be time-bound (a permanent membership is the group's members / owners), and the target group may not declare an authoritative members (owners) list, nor the principal list the group in memberOf (ownerOf). The first request onboards the group in PIM for Groups permanently; dynamic membership and on-premises synced groups are refused.

groupId.description: The target group's object id (for example [reference(resourceId('Microsoft.Entra/groups', 'ops-admins')).id]), or use group. Not both.

group.description: EARM sugar: the target group's uniqueName or object id; resolved to groupId. Not with groupId.

principalId.description: Required: object id of the user or group made an active member or owner.

accessId.description: Required: member (active membership) or owner (active ownership); any casing, sent in Graph's lowercase.

requestType.description: Optional and only AdminAssign (any casing); EARM chooses adminAssign / adminUpdate / adminRemove itself.

scheduleInfo.description: Required: the assignment period, time-bound (NoExpiration is refused: declare a permanent membership in the group's members / owners).

startDateTime.description: ISO 8601 start; absent or in the past means now (a past start is never drift).

type.description: AfterDateTime (needs endDateTime) or AfterDuration (needs duration); any casing, sent in Graph's camelCase. NoExpiration is refused.

endDateTime.description: AfterDateTime: the ISO 8601 end, after startDateTime. Compared with a 1 s tolerance.

duration.description: AfterDuration: an ISO 8601 duration such as P30D or PT8H. Applied when the assignment is created and never compared afterwards.

justification.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared (default "Deployed by earm"); PIM policy may require it.

ticketInfo.description: Request metadata, sent on every request and never compared.

permissions.notes: Learn (privilegedaccessgroup-post-assignmentschedulerequests, privilegedaccessgroup-list-assignmentschedules): PrivilegedAssignmentSchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup is the least privileged permission for the requests (delegated and application); reads need PrivilegedAssignmentSchedule.Read.AzureADGroup. Delegated callers need Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable group; for other groups Identity Governance Administrator, Groups Administrator, Directory Writers or User Administrator suffice (or the caller owns the group); the permission manifest narrows the roles to Privileged Role Administrator for a role-assignable template group that groupId references and drops it for any other template group. Directory.Read.All covers the principal-kind check and the group uniqueName lookup. The first request onboards the group in PIM for Groups permanently. The tenant needs Microsoft Entra ID P2 or ID Governance.
